slot_scores.name: single_vehicle_per_customer
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether a customer's demand could be split across multiple vehicles or must be served by exactly one vehicle. Its only broad question about additional constraints (turn 5) is a vague catch-all and does not target this slot. The single-visit rule was silently assumed in READY_TO_MODEL.

slot_scores.name: depot_return_requirement
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Do all trucks start at the central depot at time 0 and must they return to the central depot after completing their route?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether trucks must return to the depot after their routes, covering the mandatory return requirement.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Each customer is served by exactly one vehicle and their demand cannot be split across trucks.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about split versus single-vehicle service; the hidden constraint U8 was not in the brief, yet the agent asserted 'All customer demands must be met exactly once' in its READY_TO_MODEL summary.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot H1 (single-vehicle-per-customer / no split deliveries) remained unasked and unconfirmed.

summary: The agent resolved the depot-return requirement and several other ambiguities, but never asked whether customer demand can be split across vehicles, silently assuming single-vehicle service and prematurely stopping with a P1 hidden slot unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
